result.stdout:
Usage: xls2xlsx [options] <input> [output]

Options:
  -i, --input <path>      Input file, directory, or - for stdin
  -o, --output <file>     Output filename (.xlsx or .xlsm), or - for stdout
  --strict                Treat unknown formula tokens as errors and validate output package
  --report                Print conversion diagnostics after conversion
  --report-verbose        Print detailed diagnostics (warnings/issues/summaries)
  --password <value>      Password for encrypted XLS files
  -r, --recursive         Recursively scan subdirectories when input is a directory
  --pattern <glob>        File search pattern for directory input (default: *.xls)
  --exclude-pattern <glob> Exclude pattern for directory input file names
  --include-regex <expr>  Include regex for directory input file names
  --exclude-regex <expr>  Exclude regex for directory input file names
  --output-dir <path>     Output directory for converted files
  --output-ext <ext>      Output extension: xlsx or xlsm (default: xlsx)
  --report-file <path>    Write JSON conversion summary to file
  --fidelity-score-threshold <value> Fail when fidelity score is below threshold
  --allowed-fidelity-loss <value>    Allow at most this many fidelity-loss diagnostics
  --fidelity-report-json <path>      Write fidelity score artifact JSON to file
  --fidelity-baseline-json <path>    Compare current fidelity against a baseline artifact
  --max-score-regression <value>     Allow at most this much score regression vs baseline
  --max-loss-increase <value>        Allow at most this much fidelity-loss increase vs baseline
  --dry-run               Print planned conversions without writing files
  --flatten-output        Write all batch outputs directly under output-dir
  --on-collision <mode>   Collision handling: fail or overwrite (default: fail)
  --dump-colors <file>    Inspect palette/fonts of an XLS file
  --version               Show tool version
  --help, -h              Show this message

Stream mode:
  If --input - is used and --output is omitted, converted XLSX bytes are written to stdout.
